_README: OFFLINE PROVENANCE REGISTRY - lists candidate SECONDARY sources for
historical (point-in-time) S&P 500 constituent data. It records what a
candidate IS and IS NOT; it does not ingest, fetch, or trust any of them.
No entry here was fetched by this repository. No network call was made to
produce this file. Every checksum/timestamp field is either null or an
owner-supplied value recorded AFTER an owner-run validation step; this file
never fabricates one.
Hard rules enforced by tests/market_data/test_sp500_historical_source_registry.py
(all fail closed):
* classification must be exactly one of SECONDARY_RESEARCH_PIT or
NOT_FOUND_OR_COMMERCIAL_ONLY - no other value is recognised.
* every candidate.eligibility flag is FALSE, unconditionally:
- authoritative_official_evidence  (a secondary source is never official)
- eligible_for_promotion_without_validation (validation is mandatory)
- substitute_for_historical_gics   (membership history is not GICS)
* a SECONDARY_RESEARCH_PIT candidate must declare source_authority
PUBLIC_SECONDARY, must carry effective_at/observed_at/available_at
timestamp slots, and must require cross-check against at least 2
independent corroborating sources.
* checksum_status may only read VERIFIED, and cross_check.status may only
read PASSED, when ALL of the following hold simultaneously - this is
checked by re-derivation, not accepted from a label:
- artifact_path is an absolute path to a file that actually exists,
and sha256(file bytes) EQUALS checksum_sha256 (recomputed, not
trusted);
- timestamps.effective_at, .observed_at and .available_at are all
non-null, parseable ISO-8601 instants with
effective_at <= observed_at <= available_at;
- cross_check.corroborating_sources has at least
minimum_independent_corroborating_sources DISTINCT, non-empty
entries, none of which equals the candidate's own source_url.
Until every one of those holds, checksum_status/artifact_path/the three
timestamp values/cross_check.status must all stay at their not-yet-done
defaults (null / NOT_YET_COMPUTED / NOT_PERFORMED) - partial, unbound
'evidence' is rejected exactly like no evidence.
* a NOT_FOUND_OR_COMMERCIAL_ONLY candidate must carry no checksum and no
cross-check requirement - there is nothing here to validate.
This registry never authorizes Paper Auto or Live trading, never claims
integration evidence, and never edits strategy parameters (CLAUDE.md).

SECONDARY_RESEARCH_PIT.description: A non-official, third-party or community source that CLAIMS point-in-time S&P 500 membership history. May be useful for cross-checking research after independent validation. Never authoritative.

NOT_FOUND_OR_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: A candidate that could not be located as a legally accessible, unambiguous free source, or that exists only behind a commercial license/paywall. Recorded so the gap is explicit, never so the license can be bypassed.

candidates.source_name: fja05680/sp500 (community-maintained GitHub CSV of historical S&P 500 additions/removals)
notes: Community-maintained repository; not an SEC or S&P DJI official document.
Never fetched by this repository - no bytes retrieved, no checksum computed here.

Any future use requires, in order: (1) an owner-supplied snapshot file bound via artifact_path, (2) a sha256 checksum recomputed over that exact file's bytes (never trusted from a label), (3) effective/observed/available timestamps recorded and ordered, (4) a PASSED cross-check against at least 2 distinct independent sources excluding this candidate's own source_url. All four are required together before checksum_status may read VERIFIED.
Even after full validation this source remains PUBLIC_SECONDARY; it can never be relabelled OFFICIAL_PUBLIC or OWNER_PRIMARY (ADR-0017).
Carries no GICS/sector data at all and must never be cited as a GICS source.

candidates.source_name: S&P Dow Jones Indices licensed historical constituent and GICS assignment history
notes: The index owner's own historical constituent/GICS assignment data is only available under a paid license (see ADR-0017 ASOF_GICS_BLOCKER, blocker_class LICENSE_REQUIRED).
No paid provider may be integrated per owner decision; this entry records the gap, it does not authorize purchase or license circumvention.

candidates.source_name: Terminal-only index constituent history (e.g. Bloomberg, FactSet, Refinitiv)
notes: Access requires a paid market-data terminal subscription; no free or public endpoint exists.
No paid provider may be integrated per owner decision (CLAUDE.md).

candidates.source_name: Assorted unattributed finance-blog and forum 'S&P 500 additions/removals' lists
notes: No single stable, versioned, checksum-able artifact could be identified: content varies by copy, has no declared author or update methodology, and no stated primary source.
Recorded as ambiguous rather than silently dropped, so the gap stays visible.
